item.tib: bstan srung rgyal chen grags seng bskang ba 'dod 'byung gter 'phreng
item.coloph: zhes pa bstan srung rgyal chen grags seng bskang (skong) ba 'dod 'byung gter 'phreng (phreng) 'di/ dpal gshen bstan rnam rgyal kun grags gling gi mkhan chen 'dul (zla) ba rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gis bskul bzhin/ bdag 'dra snyigs ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis yi ger btab te phul//
